title: Generate Images with Diffusion and Rectified Flow
blurb: Build the maths of diffusion models: noise schedules, one-jump noising, the training loss, reverse steps, rectified-flow sampling and sampling with fewer steps.
intro: Diffusion models learn to undo gradual noising, and generate by running that reversal from pure noise. The steps turn a noise schedule into signal levels, noise data to any step in one jump, compute the noise-prediction training loss, take one reverse DDPM step, sample a rectified flow with Euler steps, and respace a schedule to sample in far fewer steps. The capstone samples a 2-D dataset with the exact optimal denoiser and shows what cutting the number of steps does to fidelity and diversity.
